answer: Histories are stored in nectar, checked in ivory, and vertex makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 19 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 24 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
